calibrationPolicy: Reserved interval remains unused for fitting, selection and uncertainty calibration; past observed prices may supply causal features.
selectionPolicy: One frozen candidate, no search, no refit using development or calibration labels, no reselection after final scores.
successRule: Assess CPU and GPU separately: final aggregate MAE must beat persistence. Report losses/ties by hardware and pool regardless of aggregate outcome; no automatic promotion.

replay.interruptionAssumption: No interruptions; capacity is a known static synthetic admission ceiling, not empirical reliability.
